W_XP_RANGE: the validator counts only unfiltered quests with XP data. It leaves out Vile Familiars (445 XP, non-Warlock), the class intro quests (40 XP each) and 5 Forever quests that have no XP rows (97279, 96821, 96825, 96652, 96604). Adding the known ones gives about 4100 XP (85% of the budget); the 5 Forever quests and all kill XP come on top. Level 6-8 Tiragarde Keep and Sen'jin quests (784, 791, 818, 96822) were moved to 05-10 on purpose: their mobs are 3+ levels above a level 4-5 solo player.

steps.note: Galgar's cooking stall is next to the Den. The apples grow in the same hills as the scorpids.

steps.note: Hana'zua is north-west of the Den. Take this before the scorpid hunt.
steps.title: Sarkoth

steps.note: Scorpid Workers cover the hills north of the Den. Their tails drop as you fight.
Cactus Apples grow on the cactuses in the same hills.
Sarkoth is a little tougher than the others, a lvl 4. Take your time.
Gornek is happy to hear about Hana'zua. Next up: the north end of the Valley.
steps.title: Sarkoth

steps.note: About level 3 now. Class trainers stand around the Den: learn what you can afford.
Duokna sells food and water. Buy a few for the trip; Hunters: check your ammo count.
Zureetha is outside the Den. The familiars live at the north end of the Valley.
steps.title: Vile Familiars

steps.note: Warlock version: bring heads from the same familiars. Ruzan stands by the Den.
steps.title: Vile Familiars

steps.note: Foreman Thazz'ril is east of the Den. He hands you a blackjack for waking sleeping peons.
steps.title: Lazy Peons

steps.note: Peons sleep in the sand right beside the foreman. Use the blackjack on 5 of them.
He lost his pick in the north end of the Valley. Look for it near the familiars.
steps.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

steps.note: Vile Familiars hang around the north end of the Valley. Kill 12.
Warlocks: collect 6 Familiar Heads from the same familiars.
The pick lies on the ground a little further north-west. Look for the glint.
Zureetha is outside the Den.
steps.title: Vile Familiars

steps.note: Yarrog Baneshadow hides in the Burning Blade cave in the north. He is lvl 5: be ready.
steps.title: Burning Blade Medallion

steps.note: Shamans: Canaga needs two Felstalker hooves from the north patch. Needs level 4.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Yarrog Baneshadow is in the Burning Blade cave in the north. He carries the medallion.
Shamans: Felstalkers wander just east of the cave. 2 hooves.

steps._review: Burning Blade Medallion cannot be accepted until Vile Familiars is turned in, and both targets sit in the same patch 12 map-% north. Two short trips are unavoidable; the third visit is the final return.
steps.note: Back to the Den. Zureetha sends you to Sen'jin Village next.
steps.title: Burning Blade Medallion

steps.note: Pick up the Lost Journal next to Zureetha. It goes to Brakk in Razor Hill, on your way.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Shamans: next you drink the Earth Sapta at the Spirit Rock, just south of the Valley.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Shamans: the Minor Manifestation of Earth waits at the Spirit Rock. Drink the Sapta there.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Shamans: this earns your Earth Totem, a core class tool. Walk back to Canaga.
steps.title: Call of Earth

steps.note: Level 4 spells are ready. Visit your class trainer in the Den once more before you leave.
Ukor is a peon by the road, east of the Valley. His burden goes to the Razor Hill innkeeper.
steps.title: A Peon's Burden

steps.note: Follow the road east and south to Sen'jin Village. It is a quiet trip.
Master Gadrin is by the main huts in Sen'jin Village.
steps.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

steps.note: He sends you to Orgnil in Razor Hill. You are done in Sen'jin.
steps.title: Report to Orgnil

steps.note: Vel'rin Fang stands next to Gadrin. The Ridgeshade mobs are on the road north.
steps.title: Legging It

steps.note: Ridgeshade Creepers and Lurkers (lvl 5-6) are beside the road north. Kill 6 of each.
Orgnil Soulscar is in the big hut in Razor Hill. His next quests start the next leg.
steps.title: Report to Orgnil

steps.note: Gar'Thok is next to Orgnil.
steps.title: Legging It

steps.note: Innkeeper Grosk takes Ukor's burden. You get water and bread.
steps.title: A Peon's Burden

steps.note: Make Razor Hill your home at Innkeeper Grosk.
Sell grey items at the general goods vendor here. Repair if your gear is damaged.
Cook Torka wants prickly pears from the grounds west of town. Needs level 3.
steps.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

steps.note: Brakk stands just south of town. He takes the journal.
steps.title: The Adventurer

steps.note: Sit down next to Brakk's campfire until you get the Boosted Rest buff.
Prickly pears grow on the cactus patch west of town. Collect 8.
